capture_status_detail: No profile data could be retrieved from Instagram or any public mirror without logging in. Every field below that is null was not observed; none of it is fabricated. See README.md for the per-route HTTP evidence.

username_resolution_evidence.summary: CORRECTED 2026-09-21T04:40Z: the 'httpErrorPage'/'PolarisErrorRoot' shell first read as a 404 signal is NOT evidence about the username; the certainly-live profile /aluzinaa/ returned the identical shell (aluzinaa/raw/control_aluzinaa_shell.html, HTTP 200, 04:36:09Z). Instagram serves that shell to any unauthenticated datacenter client here. Remaining evidence that aluzina.espacios is not the live handle is circumstantial: the company website links only to @aluzinaa, search engines index no instagram.com/aluzina.espacios page, and the one mirror that rendered showed zero counts with a generic 'does not exist' string.

username_resolution_evidence.search_engines: WebSearch (two queries) and a Bing "aluzina.espacios" site:instagram.com query returned no instagram.com/aluzina.espacios result (Bing returned 7 unrelated non-instagram pages). DuckDuckGo answered with a bot-challenge page (HTTP 202), no data. All Instagram results WebSearch returned for the company point to instagram.com/aluzinaa.
